findings.message: index.html is only scanned for double-quoted src/href attributes, so an inline <script>fetch('/api')</script> or a single-quoted <script src='https://cdn/...'> passes --check-source and the copied build violates the static contract the Play page promises. Scan the whole index for the same forbidden runtime tokens and accept both quote styles.

frameLooksLoaded rejects a loaded game unless the iframe document's title contains the catalog title, so a game whose <title> differs (nothing in the playable contract requires a match) gets the ten-second 'did not start' panel over a working game. Check the body markers first and keep the title only as a fallback signal.

check_manifest builds the listed set from every string in builds, so a malformed entry such as "x" raises IndexError and --check prints a traceback instead of the unsafe-path problem it just recorded. Take the commit segment only from paths that passed the build-path guard.
